Title: Kashmir Royal Houseboat & Gulmarg Ski Odyssey
Description: Experience paradise on earth with luxury handcrafted houseboats on Dal Lake and heated pine chalets in Gulmarg.
Inclusions: 5-Star Stay; Private Cab; Daily Breakfast & Dinner; Shikara Ride; VIP Gondola Passes
Day1_Desc: VIP pickup from Srinagar airport and transfer to Royal Cedar Houseboat on Nigeen Lake with sunset Shikara ride.
Day2_Desc: Drive through pine valleys to Gulmarg. Check into heated alpine chalet and take Gondola Phase 1 & 2.
Day3_Desc: Skiing and snowboarding with certified instructors. Evening bonfire with Kashmiri Kahwa.
Day4_Desc: Scenic drive to Lidder River valley. Check into riverside pine cottages.
Day5_Desc: Visit Betaab Valley and Aru Valley. Evening shopping at Lal Chowk and airport drop.

Title: Bali Romance: Jungle Pool Villas & Uluwatu Sunset
Description: Romantic split stay between Ubud rainforest infinity pools and Uluwatu ocean clifftop luxury suites.
Inclusions: Private Pool Villa; Daily Floating Breakfast; Candlelight Dinner; Sunset Cruise; 24/7 Concierge
Day1_Desc: Traditional Balinese flower garland welcome, private VIP transfer to Ubud Jungle Villa.
Day2_Desc: Explore iconic green terraces, Aloha swing, and sacred Tirta Empul water temple.
Day3_Title: Ubud to Seminyak & Sunset Beach Club
Day3_Desc: Transfer to luxury Seminyak beachfront suite. Sunset cocktails at Potato Head Beach Club.
Day4_Title: Nusa Penida Island Private Speedboat Tour
Day4_Desc: Fast boat to Kelingking T-Rex Beach, Broken Beach, and Angel's Billabong snorkeling.
Day5_Desc: Cliffside Uluwatu temple tour and traditional sunset fire dance with Jimbaran seafood dinner.

Title: Dubai Extravaganza: Desert Luxury & Burj Khalifa VIP
Description: Ultra-modern luxury with 5-star Marina hotels, private yacht cruise, and premium desert safari glamping.
Inclusions: 5-Star Hotel; Desert Safari; Private Yacht; Burj 124th Floor; Limousine Airport Transfer
Day1_Desc: Limousine airport transfer to 5-star Dubai Marina hotel. Evening Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise.
Day2_Title: Dubai City Tour & Burj Khalifa At The Top
Day2_Desc: Visit Museum of the Future, Dubai Mall, and 124th-floor sunset Burj Khalifa VIP entry.
Day3_Desc: Luxury 4x4 dune bashing, camel riding, quad biking, and gourmet Arabian BBQ dinner with live Tanoura show.
Day4_Title: Private Luxury Yacht Cruise & Atlantis Aquaventure
Day4_Desc: 2-hour private yacht cruise along Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah with Atlantis Aquaventure pass.
Day5_Desc: Morning shopping at traditional Deira Gold and Spice Souks. VIP airport drop-off.

Title: Kerala Serenity: Munnar Tea Hills & Alleppey Houseboat
Description: Lush tea plantation mists, aromatic spice gardens, and private luxury backwater houseboat cruises.
Inclusions: Luxury Resort; Private Houseboat; All Meals on Boat; Ayurvedic Spa Voucher; Private AC Cab
Day1_Desc: Scenic drive past Cheeyappara waterfalls to Munnar tea country. Check-in to plantation resort.
Day2_Title: Munnar Tea Gardens & Eravikulam National Park
Day2_Desc: Visit Nilgiri Tahr sanctuary, Mattupetty Dam, and Tata Tea Museum with tea-tasting session.
Day3_Desc: Scenic drive to Periyar. Guided spice plantation walk and Periyar lake boat safari.
Day4_Desc: Board private luxury AC houseboat. Cruise through palm-fringed backwaters with authentic Kerala lunch.
Day5_Desc: Morning sunrise village cruise, visit Fort Kochi Chinese Fishing Nets, and airport transfer.

Title: Swiss Alps & Glacier Express Fantasy
Description: First-class panoramic Swiss rail pass, Jungfraujoch Top of Europe, and Lake Lucerne steam cruises.
Inclusions: 4-Star Superior Hotels; Swiss Travel Pass 1st Class; Jungfraujoch Ticket; Lake Lucerne Cruise
Day1_Desc: Scenic Swiss rail to Lucerne. Walk across historical Chapel Bridge and Lion Monument.
Day2_Desc: Rotair cable car to 10,000 ft, glacier cave walk, and Cliff Walk suspension bridge.
Day3_Desc: Panoramic train journey along scenic turquoise lakes to alpine Interlaken resort.
Day4_Desc: Cogwheel train to highest railway station in Europe (3,454m) with Ice Palace tour.
Day5_Desc: Scenic lake cruise on Lake Brienz, transfer to Zurich for airport departure.
